fact: The World Bank's June 2026 project paper says Togo's technology service provider contract reached US$52.7 million, that the additional financing is a bridge to follow-on operations 'rather than achieving full operational autonomy', and that the focus is shifting to sustained operation and reducing vendor dependency.
title: Project Paper on a proposed additional credit to the Republic of Benin and to the Republic of Togo for the West Africa Unique Identification for Regional Integration and Inclusion - Phase 2 (P169594)
